description: F2P/P2P classification of this task's graded observations. F2P fail on the delivered state and pass after the reference repair; P2P pass on both. Measured in the task image, not derived from names. tests/grade.py reads this file and runs exactly the observations it names.

groups.requirement: SomeOf(num_transforms=(min, max)) applies between min and max transforms, both ends included
Choice repr shows the values with one decimal and the probabilities with two decimals
a 6-tuple parameter is (lo0, hi0, lo1, hi1, lo2, hi2), one (lo, hi) range per axis
the inverse of a transform history undoes the transforms in reverse order
Lambda(types_to_apply='scalar') changes only ScalarImages and 'label' only LabelMaps
Flip resolves an anatomical axis label from its first letter only
EnsureShapeMultiple((n_i, n_j, n_k)) makes the size along axis d a multiple of n_d
Transpose swaps the I and K columns of the affine, so spacing and orientation follow the swapped axes and world coordinates stay consistent
Resize keeps the physical extent: each spacing is multiplied by old size / new size and the origin is unchanged
Crop with three values (i, j, k) crops i voxels from both ends of the first axis, j from the second and k from the third
Normalize clips intensities to the input range before rescaling (CT windowing)
Gamma maps negative values to sign(I) * |I| ** gamma
Blur standard deviations are in mm and are converted to voxels by dividing by the spacing
Standardize computes the mean and the standard deviation from the masked voxels and applies them to the whole image
Mask(labels=[...]) treats exactly the listed label values as inside the mask
RemapLabels replaces each original value by its new value, so swapping two labels works
SequentialLabels maps the smallest label to 0 and the others to consecutive integers, also when there are no zeros
OneHot with the default num_classes=-1 infers max_label + 1 channels
KeepLargestComponent uses 26-connectivity by default (fully_connected=True) and 6-connectivity with fully_connected=False
AffineMatrix.spacing is the norm of each column of the rotation-zoom block
AffineMatrix.compose(other) and a @ b return the matrix product self @ other
slicing an image moves its origin to the world position of the first kept voxel (the affine is applied to the start index)
converting corner boxes to center/size gives the center and the corner difference as the size
get_axis_mapping gives, for each target column, the index of the source column; Points.to_axes reorders voxel axes accordingly
an explicit affine= on a NiBabel source overrides the header affine in the lazy backend too (image.dataobj.affine agrees with image.affine)
Queue shuffles and empties its buffer as soon as it holds at least max_length patches
PatchAggregator 'crop' mode trims patch_overlap // 2 voxels from each inner patch side, so odd overlaps tile without gaps
every integer index, negative ones included, selects exactly one element and keeps its axis with size 1
locked_borders=n zeros the n outermost control-point layers at both ends of every axis
default_pad_value='otsu' averages the face voxels strictly below their Otsu threshold
Affine translation is applied in world coordinates, not rotated or scaled by the sampled rotation and scales
a SimpleITK image keeps its direction cosines through a transform round trip
with both include and exclude, a transform applies only to images listed in include and not in exclude
CopyAffine ignores include and exclude and copies the target affine to every other image
Anisotropy accepts a downsampling range with a lower bound below 1 and rejects only an upper bound below 1
BiasField with per_instance=False shares the parameters but draws a different field for each batch element
percentile statistics interpolate linearly between neighbouring order statistics like torch.quantile
PCA(whiten=True) scales every component to unit variance
Motion keeps the first k-space segment and fills every later segment from a transformed image
LabelsToImage(ignore_background=True) leaves only label value 0 as zero
